name: tabs-products
description: A tabbed product showcase built from repeatable panel items (label, richtext content, image, image alt); a generated tab bar switches between panels, each rendering a two-column layout of text (eyebrow, title, checkmark list, CTA) beside an image.

contentPattern.structure: One row per tab: cell 0 is the tab label, cell 1 is the panel richtext, cell 2 is the panel image; a tab bar is generated and clicking a tab reveals its two-column panel
